reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the sachets: one-hand tear, pocket size, so they fit in a carry-on, and the QR lab report on every sachet is more than the three brands I already tried gave me. I would buy one box to try, not set up auto-ship.
objection: Nothing says how big the capsules are, and I already dislike big size 00 ones. Two of them at once could be a problem. It is also about $1 a serving with no reviews, which is a lot more than the bottles I compare it to.
would_change_my_mind: A stated capsule size that is small enough to swallow easily, plus a few real reviews, or a lower price per serving.
